name: @dszp/flexpoint-lib
description: Portable, Node-free, read-only client for the FlexPoint merchant API: automatic token login and refresh, lossless int64 ids, and complete-list walkers checked against record-count. Runs unchanged in a Cloudflare Worker, Node, or the browser.
//publishConfig: No `provenance: true` here on purpose: it would force provenance on EVERY publish, including the manual first one that a brand-new package requires (npm can only configure trusted publishing on a package that already exists). Provenance comes from the workflow's explicit `npm publish --provenance` in CI.

..//require: ESM-only package. This `require` condition lets Node >=22.12 load it via require(esm); older Node still gets an accurate ERR_REQUIRE_ESM here instead of the confusing ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED the bare export map produced.

//files: The maps and `src` ship together on purpose: tsc writes a sourceMappingURL pointer into every dist file and the .d.ts.map references ../src/*.ts, so a Worker stack trace names a real .ts line and Go-to-Definition opens actual source. Tests and the mock-fetch harness are excluded by negation so they stay beside the code they test without shipping.

scripts.//verify: Build, then actually IMPORT the built entry point with Node. `pnpm build` and `vitest run` both pass on a dist that cannot be loaded (tsc emits relative specifiers verbatim; vitest resolves extensionless ones). This checks the artefact a consumer actually gets.
scripts.verify: pnpm build && node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { if (!Object.keys(m).length) { throw new Error('dist/index.js exported nothing'); } console.log('verify: dist imports cleanly,', Object.keys(m).length, 'exports'); })"
